name: Surya Namaskar (Sun Salutation)
formCue: Move with your breath; keep a soft bend in your knees on forward folds.
voiceIntro: Stand at the top of your mat. Hands at heart center. Let's flow through Surya Namaskar at your own steady rhythm.

name: Chandra Namaskar (Moon Salutation)
formCue: Open your chest during side bends; keep movements slow and cooling.
voiceIntro: Stand tall on your mat. Take a deep breath in and begin your slow, cooling Chandra Namaskar flow.

name: Banded Glute Bridge
formCue: Push knees gently outward against the band; squeeze glutes at the top without arching your lower back.
voiceIntro: Lie on your back with the resistance band above your knees. Feet flat, hip-width apart. Drive through your heels and lift.

name: Standing Lateral Band Walk
formCue: Keep a slight quarter-squat and toes pointing straight ahead; step sideways with control.
voiceIntro: Place the band above your knees or ankles. Drop into a mini squat and take two controlled steps right, then two steps left.

name: Isometric Lateral Wall Push
formCue: Stand next to a wall, lift the inside leg slightly, and press the outside of that knee into the wall while keeping hips level.
voiceIntro: Stand sideways next to a wall. Lift your inner foot slightly and press your outer knee gently into the wall. Hold steady and breathe.

name: Standing Banded Hip Abduction
formCue: Hold a wall or chair for balance; keep your torso upright as you lift one leg slightly out to the side.
voiceIntro: Band around your ankles, one hand on a wall for support. Keep your chest tall and slowly press one leg out to the side.

name: Seated Inner-Thigh Trainer Squeeze
formCue: Sit tall with feet flat on the floor; squeeze the pads smoothly and hold for 2 seconds before releasing.
voiceIntro: Sit tall on a chair or mat with your purple thigh trainer securely between your thighs. Exhale as you squeeze, hold, and slowly release.

name: Glute Bridge with Thigh Trainer
formCue: Squeeze the thigh trainer gently as you lift your hips into a bridge; keep ribs tucked.
voiceIntro: Lie on your back with the thigh trainer between your knees. Squeeze gently as you press your hips up toward the ceiling.

name: Slow-Tempo Bodyweight Squat
formCue: Keep knees aligned with your middle toes; lower for 3 full seconds, pause, then stand.
voiceIntro: Feet shoulder-width apart. We are going slow for maximum burn. Down for three, two, one... pause... and drive back up.

name: Supported Standing Hip Extension
formCue: Rest hands on a table or chair back; extend one leg straight behind you by squeezing the glute, not arching the back.
voiceIntro: Stand facing a wall or chair back with your hands supported. Keep your spine neutral and lift one leg straight back behind you.

name: 1kg Dumbbell Bent-Over Row
formCue: Hinge at the hips with a flat back; pull elbows close to your ribs and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
voiceIntro: Grab your 1 kg dumbbells. Hinge forward slightly with a flat back. Pull your elbows back and squeeze your shoulder blades.

name: 1kg Dumbbell Reverse Fly
formCue: Keep a soft bend in your elbows; lift arms out to the sides to shoulder height with control.
voiceIntro: With your 1 kg dumbbells, hinge forward slightly. Open your arms wide like wings, squeezing your upper back.

name: 1kg Dumbbell Overhead Press
formCue: Engage your core so your lower back doesn't arch; press straight up and lower slowly.
voiceIntro: Hold your dumbbells at shoulder height, palms forward. Press straight overhead, then lower down slowly for three seconds.

name: 1kg Dumbbell Curl & Kickback
formCue: Keep elbows pinned to your sides; avoid swinging your torso.
voiceIntro: Dumbbells at your sides. Curl up smoothly, lower down, then press back slightly to wake up the backs of your arms.

name: Gentle Cobra Back Extension
formCue: Press tops of feet into the mat; lift your chest using your back muscles with minimal pressure in your hands.
voiceIntro: Lie on your stomach, hands under your shoulders. Inhale and gently lift your chest using your back strength. Hold, then lower.

name: Tabletop Bird-Dog
formCue: Extend opposite arm and leg without letting your hips tilt; keep your gaze down at the mat.
voiceIntro: Come onto hands and knees. Extend your right arm forward and left leg back. Hold steady, then switch sides.

name: Brisk Walk-at-Home March
formCue: Pump your arms briskly and land softly on the balls of your feet.
voiceIntro: Let's pick up the energy! March briskly in place, swinging your arms strong and steady.

name: Rhythmic Side Steps with Arm Pulls
formCue: Step wide to the right and tap, then left; pull your elbows back as you step to engage your upper back.
voiceIntro: Step right, tap, step left, tap! Add strong arm pulls every time you step to get your heart rate up.

name: Power Standing Knee Lifts
formCue: Lift knees to hip height while pulling your hands down toward your knee; keep your chest proud.
voiceIntro: Alternate lifting your knees high in front of you, reaching your arms up and pulling down with every lift!

name: Fast Front & Cross Punches
formCue: Keep a soft bend in your knees and pivot slightly through your core as you punch forward.
voiceIntro: Wide stance, knees soft, fists up! Punch forward fast—left, right, left, right. Let out all that energy!

name: Cat-Cow Spine Decompression
formCue: Inhale as you drop your belly and lift your gaze; exhale as you round your spine.
voiceIntro: Come onto hands and knees. Inhale to arch your back gently, exhale to round your spine toward the ceiling.

name: Supine Figure-4 Glute Stretch
formCue: Lie on your back, cross one ankle over the opposite thigh, and gently draw the bottom leg in until you feel a comfortable release.
voiceIntro: Lie on your back. Cross your right ankle over your left thigh and gently pull your left knee toward your chest. Breathe deeply.

name: Gentle Supine Knee Rocking
formCue: Keep knees together and feet flat; let your knees rock slowly side to side like windshield wipers.
voiceIntro: Stay on your back with knees bent. Slowly let both knees rock to the right, back to center, and over to the left.

name: Seated 4-4-4-4 Afterglow Breathing
formCue: Sit comfortably with shoulders relaxed; inhale for 4, hold for 4, exhale for 4, hold for 4.
voiceIntro: Sit comfortably and close your eyes. Inhale for four... hold for four... exhale slowly for four... and soak in that afterglow.
